title: Deck Rats
short_description: Sail a changing Caribbean. Explore a growing archipelago, command sailing ships, face shifting weather and build your name as a pirate in Deck Rats, an in-development first-person adventure.
project_description:
Deck Rats is an in-development first-person pirate adventure set across a Caribbean archipelago. Set out from the tavern, sail between distinctive island regions, and contend with weather that moves across the sea. Ship handling, crew systems, exploration and combat are being built together around a living world in Unreal Engine 5.8.

This preview leads with recent in-game development captures and separates them from environment studies and concept art. It presents a work in progress, not a release announcement or a claim of ecosystem endorsement.
media_disclosure: In-game captures are dated 7 November 2026 and have been cropped only to remove temporary debug banners. The environment studies are in-engine captures dated 12 November 2026. Concept artwork is clearly labelled and is not gameplay.
